programme.title: The First Omen
programme.desc: A young American woman sent to Rome to begin a life of service to the church encounters a darkness that causes her to question her faith and uncovers a terrifying conspiracy.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Captain Mike Steele leads a team of nearly 100 US Army Rangers who travel to the capital city of Mogadishu to catch the top two lieutenants of a Somali warlord.

programme.title: Darkroom
programme.desc: Michelle accepts a professional role suggested by her advisor. This position confines her within a residence where three deranged relatives attempt to cleanse her soul.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Lao Luo and his horse achieve instant worldwide fame through a recorded physical altercation against creditors. This veteran performer and his equine companion gain immense popularity after the intense encounter becomes a trend.

programme.title: The King's Man
programme.desc: One man must race against time to stop history's worst tyrants and criminal masterminds from wiping out millions of people.

programme.title: Independence Day
programme.desc: With access to high-tech weapons, aliens attack major cities of the world. So, to save the human race, some survivors team up to battle them.

programme.title: The Maze Runner
programme.desc: A boy finds himself trapped in a gigantic maze with no memories of his past. However, he must work with other boys like him to escape the maze and discover the truth.

programme.title: The First Omen
programme.desc: A young American woman sent to Rome to begin a life of service to the church encounters a darkness that causes her to question her faith and uncovers a terrifying conspiracy.

programme.title: The Avengers
programme.desc: Nick Fury is compelled to launch the Avengers Initiative when Loki poses a threat to planet Earth. Eventually, the superheroes cast their differences aside to accomplish the task.

programme.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
programme.desc: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner use Loki's Sceptre to complete Ultron, Tony's AI program. However, when the sentient Ultron makes plans to eliminate mankind, the Avengers set out to stop him.

programme.title: Avengers: Infinity War
programme.desc: The Avengers and their allies set out to stop Thanos, an alien warlord, from acquiring the Infinity Stones as he plans to eliminate half of all life from the universe using them.

programme.title: Avengers: Endgame
programme.desc: After Thanos, an intergalactic warlord, disintegrates half of all life in the universe, the Avengers rally together to reverse his act and defeat him once and for all.

programme.title: The Shallows
programme.desc: A woman journeys to a secluded beach following her mother's death and while surfing, she gets attacked by a great white shark, which leaves her stranded on a rock.

programme.title: Cars 3
programme.desc: Lighting McQueen, a legendary racer, is overcome by new generation racers. Later, he sets out to prove that he is the best racer in the world with the help of a technician, Cruz Ramirez.

programme.title: John Carter
programme.desc: John Carter finds himself transported to Mars, where he learns about his superhuman capabilities. Things take a turn when he rescues a princess who is on the run.

programme.title: Samson
programme.desc: Samson, a Hebrew with extraordinary strength, must use his God-given gift to rally his people to freedom from the evil Philistines.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Catch The Dragon
programme.desc: A palaeontology expert embarks on a quest with a skilled hunter and a mechanic to hunt dragons and uncover the truth about his father's death.

programme.title: Shark Island
programme.desc: Four friends in a resort island have to save themselves from genetically modified sharks while trying to find a cure in a nearby research centre.

programme.title: Toy Story 2
programme.desc: Buzz Lightyear and the other toys set out to find Woody, after he is kidnapped by a toy collector. Woody meets new toys which makes him rethink his life.

programme.title: Hansel and Gretel
programme.desc: A deranged recluse enslaves teenage siblings in her horrifying home.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
programme.desc: Siblings Edmund and Lucy return to the fantasy realm of Narnia with their cousin, Eustace. Soon, the trio embarks on a voyage across the seas with an old friend to rescue seven lords.

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Alex, Marty, Gloria, and Melman are back and still trying to return to New York. When their journey brings them to Europe, they use a travelling circus as the perfect cover.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: Percy Jackson, a young demigod, sets off on a quest to find the Golden Fleece in the Sea of Monsters along with his half-brother, Tyson, and friends, Annabeth and Grover.

programme.title: Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue
programme.desc: When Tinker Bell is trapped, she befriends a lonely human child named Lizzy, while the other fairies embark on a daring rescue mission.

programme.title: Rio 2
programme.desc: Blu and his family travel to the jungles of Amazon to help look for other blue macaws. However, trouble brews ahead as illegal loggers threaten to destroy their natural habitat.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: After a devastating flood separates him from his family, Arlo teams up with a young human called Spot as they journey across dangerous lands to find their way home.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: Mark Watney is stranded on the planet of Mars after his crew leaves him behind, presuming him to be dead due to a storm. With minimum supplies, Mark struggles to keep himself alive.

programme.title: Cruella
programme.desc: Estella, a street-smart grifter, pursues fashion dreams in London. Meeting a famous designer awakens her dark side, turning her into the rebellious Cruella.

programme.title: ఎటో వెళ్ళిపోయింది మనసు
programme.desc: చిన్నతనం నుండి యుక్తవయసు వరకు వరుణ్, నిత్యల బంధంలో ఎదురైన సవాళ్ల కారణంగా వారి మధ్య విభేదాలు తలెత్తుతాయి.

programme.title: మాస్ట్రో
programme.desc: అంధుడిగా నటిస్తూ రెస్టారెంట్ లో స్థిరమైన ఉద్యోగం పొందిన పియానిస్ట్, ఒక హత్యను చూసినప్పుడు తన ఉచ్చులో తానే చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: స్లాట్ - అడిక్షన్ కిల్లర్
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: ఫన్ టైమ్
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: నవ మన్మధుడు
programme.desc: తమిళ్ తన తండ్రి ఆత్మహత్య వెనుక ఉన్న నిజమైన కారణాలను పరిశోధిస్తాడు.అతని దర్యాప్తు దాచిన రహస్యాలను బహిర్గతం చేస్తుంది.

programme.title: జల్సా

programme.title: உல்வ்ஸ்: பவர் ஆஃப் த பேக்
programme.desc: ஆர்க்டிக் துந்திரா முதல் பரந்த சமவெளிகள் வரை, ஓநாய்களின் ஆதிக்கம் வட அரைக்கோளம் முழுவதும் பரவியுள்ள இந்த ஓநாய்கள் வனப்பகுதியின் அடையாளங்களாகவும், வாள்முனையில் வாழ்ந்து மடியும் அற்புதமான உயிரினங்களாகவும் திகழ்கின்றன.

programme.title: Super snakes
programme.desc: Snakes are a feature of nearly every culture in the world. 100,000 people die every year because of them. But we also owe our survival to snake predation on rodents. They attract a mythology which sometimes leaves the truth eating dust.

programme.title: யூரோப்'ஸ் அமேசான்
programme.desc: டிராவா மற்றும் டான்யூப் நதிகளின் குறுக்குவெட்டில் அமைந்துள்ள ஈரநில சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பு பெரும்பாலும் கண்டுபிடிக்கப்படாத இரும்புத் திரைக்குப் பின்னால் மறைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

programme.title: ப்ரதர்ஹூட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்

programme.title: நேச்சுரல் பார்ன் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.
